slots.class: every class passive is active from its unlock level

passives.name: Doorstop
passives.text: Each time you are hit by an attack that was aimed at an ally, or that Provoked, Taunt, Covered or Bulwark pulled onto you, gain 8 Limit. At most twice per round.
passives.choice: Hits aimed at you from the start earn nothing. Your gauge only fills while you are doing the most dangerous thing available.

passives.name: Stubborn
passives.text: Binds on your arms and legs last 1 turn less, to a minimum of 1. Binds on your head last 1 turn longer.
passives.choice: Your body shrugs off what your head cannot. Every head bind is a longer stretch at half Willpower with your shouts sealed.

passives.name: Bodyguard's Reflex
passives.text: Once per round, when a single-target attack is aimed at an ally below 30% HP, you take it instead as if they were Covered. Your legs must be free. You cannot decline.
passives.choice: It is a reflex, not a decision. It fires when you are the one who cannot afford the hit, and it goes to the first ally in trouble, not the one you would have picked.

passives.name: Seeing Red
passives.text: For every 25 stress you carry, your Might is ×1.05 higher and your Willpower ×0.95 lower, up to Might ×1.2 and Willpower ×0.8 at 100 stress.
passives.choice: Stress you keep is damage you deal and magic you eat. Calming the warrior down also turns the warrior down.

passives.name: Share the Shield
passives.text: When you use the Guard action, the ally with the lowest share of HP also gains Guard until their next turn. Your own Guard that turn is ×0.6 damage instead of ×0.5.
passives.choice: You give away part of your cover every time, wanted or not: two people half protected instead of one door properly shut.

passives.name: Last One Standing
passives.text: While at least one ally is down, your Might and Constitution are ×1.25, and at the start of each of your turns you gain 10 Limit and take 5 stress.
passives.choice: Your best form arrives exactly when things are worst, and it bills your nerves every turn you stay in it. Reviving the ally ends both.

passives.name: Marginalia
passives.text: The first time each battle you hit an enemy with a given element, its affinity to that element is revealed to the party and you gain 6 Limit. Whenever one of your spells hits a weakness, you gain 8 Limit.
passives.choice: The gauge pays for research and for being right, not for repeating a safe spell. Testing an element costs a turn, and the answer may be "resisted".

passives.name: I Told You So
passives.text: When your spell hits a weakness, your next skill costs half MP. When your spell is resisted, nulled or absorbed, you take 5 stress that Willpower cannot reduce.
passives.choice: Being right is cheap and being wrong is personal. Guessing at an unknown enemy now risks your nerve as well as your turn.

passives.name: Ivory Tower
passives.text: While you are at full HP your Arcana is ×1.15. While you are below 50% HP it is ×0.9.
passives.choice: Your best work needs you untouched, so the party pays to keep you that way, and one good shove moves you from the first number to the second.

passives.name: Bedside Manner
passives.text: Your healing on an ally below 30% HP is ×1.3. Your healing on an ally above 70% HP is ×0.7.
passives.choice: Topping people up is wasteful; waiting until it is nearly too late is efficient and frightening. You choose how close to the edge to let them get.

passives.name: Chain of Thought
passives.text: Each damaging spell you cast of a different element from your previous spell deals 10% more damage, building to 30%. Repeating an element, or doing anything else with your turn, resets it to nothing.
passives.choice: Rotating elements builds the bonus; hammering the one weakness you found throws it away. So does stopping to heal.

passives.name: Mind Over Matter
passives.text: Once per round, when a hit would take you to 0 HP, you stay at 1 HP and pay the rest of that hit from MP at 1 MP per 4 HP. If you cannot pay all of it, the hit lands in full and no MP is spent.
passives.choice: It is automatic. Every MP held back as armor is a spell not cast, and every spell cast is armor spent.

passives.name: Sticky Fingers
passives.text: Gain 6 Limit each time you land a crit and each time you inflict a bind.
passives.choice: Plain hits earn nothing. A careful rogue has an empty gauge; a greedy one is fishing for crits with skills that miss more often.

passives.name: First In
passives.text: In the first two rounds of a battle your attacks get +15 to crit. From round six onward they get −10 to hit.
passives.choice: You are built for the opening, not the siege. A long fight turns your best trait into a penalty, so end it early or be carried.

passives.name: Opportunist
passives.text: When you crit with a skill that carries a bind, the bind ignores the target's bind resistance and the wear from earlier binds. When such a skill hits without a crit, any bind it lands lasts 1 turn less, to a minimum of 1.
passives.choice: Your binds become bets on your crits. Setting up Marked or Hidden lets you tie up a boss; skipping the setup leaves you with the shortest binds in the party.

passives.name: Travelling Light
passives.text: The first attack aimed at you each round gets −15 to hit. Any attack that hits you while you are above 50% HP deals ×1.15 damage.
passives.choice: Harder to touch, softer when touched. The one hit that does connect is the one that counts.

passives.name: Kick 'Em While They're Down
passives.text: You deal ×1.25 damage to a target with at least one bound part and ×0.9 damage to a target with none.
passives.choice: You are the best in the party at finishing a tied-up enemy and the worst at opening on a free one. Something has to land a bind first.

passives.name: Cut and Run
passives.text: When you defeat an enemy you become Hidden for 1 turn. When an ally is defeated you take 8 stress that Willpower cannot reduce.
passives.choice: You get out clean after every kill, which leaves your friends holding the room, and you feel it when one of them pays for that.

passives.name: Quartermaster
passives.text: Recovery and MP items you use on an ally restore 25% more. The same items used on yourself restore 25% less.
passives.choice: This character is the party's medic or its own, not both. Somebody else has to keep them on their feet.

passives.name: Deep Breaths
passives.text: When you use the Guard action you shed 4 stress. You gain no Limit during any round in which you Guard.
passives.choice: A turn spent breathing is a turn not spent building toward your ultimate, or doing anything else.

passives.name: Lucky Charm
passives.text: Once per battle, the first fumble you roll counts as a plain miss instead. From then until the battle ends your attacks get −5 to crit.
passives.choice: You buy off one disaster with a little of every success that follows. On Valerie it also cancels an Accidental Chaos Wave.

passives.name: Gallows Humour
passives.text: You take no stress from death sources, and you shed 5 stress whenever an enemy is defeated. Embarrassment stress on you is ×1.5.
passives.choice: Nothing grim gets to you and everything silly does. A heckle or a public pratfall lands harder than a lich.
